one_line: LLMs edit weights, Anthropic spends compute, AI firms acquire startups, NVIDIA expands services and simulation speed.

themes.title: LLMs edit and read weights
themes.text: MIT researchers demonstrated that GPT‑6 Astra can modify a neural network’s weights by changing only 0.016% of parameters, raising math scores dramatically. Separately, Simon Willison showed that the Qwen 3.8 27B model can read and reason about raw model weights on a laptop.

stories.headline: MIT researchers show LLMs can read and edit neural network weights without retraining
GPT-6 Astra edits 0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B weights, boosting math performance sixfold
Simon Willison shows Qwen 3.8 27B can interpret raw model weights

themes.title: Anthropic reports huge revenue rise
themes.text: Anthropic’s Q3 revenue grew to $17 billion, a 1,100% year‑over‑year increase, while compute spending reached $10 billion, representing 58% of revenue.

stories.headline: Anthropic compute costs rise to 58% of revenue in Q3, widening operating loss
Anthropic reports 1,100% revenue surge ahead of IPO, commits $895B to compute

themes.title: AI firms pursue acquisitions
themes.text: Salesforce agreed to buy Cresta for $2.7 billion, and CrowdStrike announced purchases of Fiddler AI for $400 million and Dreadnode for $95 million. Meanwhile, Trajectory raised $45 million Series A and PowerUp Money secured $10 million to expand AI‑led services.

stories.headline: Salesforce to acquire Cresta for $2.7 billion
CrowdStrike to acquire Fiddler AI for $400 million and Dreadnode for $95 million
Trajectory raises $45 million Series A to automate AI model post‑training
PowerUp Money raises $10 million to expand AI‑led wealth management in India

themes.title: NVIDIA expands AI services
themes.text: NVIDIA and partners are deploying physical and agentic AI, including digital twins, in cities across Europe, Asia and the United States. NVIDIA’s cuDSS and PhysicsNeMo libraries also deliver up to 35× faster semiconductor simulations for industry customers.

stories.headline: NVIDIA expands physical and agentic AI services to cities worldwide
AI accelerates semiconductor fab simulations up to 35x
